capabilities: Log daily recitation by page or by surah
Show khatm progress on a juz or surah map with an estimated completion date
Track daily goals, streaks, a weekly chart and a heat map
Report page, surah and combined totals separately
Store each session as a list item in a daily Markdown note with frontmatter properties
disambiguation: Not an audio recorder or recitation player; it only logs reading progress as text in daily notes.
extras: Interface is Persian only and uses the Jalali calendar; English and Arabic interfaces are planned. Page numbers follow the Madinah Mushaf (604 pages). The plugin makes no network requests and collects no data.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to log daily Quran reading and follow progress toward a complete khatm.

relations.evidence: kept up to date so you can query them with Bases or Dataview
kept up to date so you can query them with Bases or Dataview

summary: Tracker for daily Quran recitation by page or surah, with a khatm progress map, goals, streaks and reports kept in daily notes.
